runs.question: How did engine_getBlobs response time scale with blob count for each execution client on mainnet on 8 June 2026 (UTC)?
runs.answer:
Here's how `engine_getBlobs` response time scaled with blob count per EL client on mainnet, June 8, 2026:

| Client | 1 blob (ms) | 6 blobs (ms) | 12 blobs (ms) | 18 blobs (ms) | 21 blobs (ms) | Scaling pattern |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Nethermind** | 0 (med) | 5 (med) | 0 (med) | 0 (med) | 0 (med) | Near-flat, fastest |
| **Reth** | 1 (med) | 5 (med) | 10 (med) | 18.5 (med) | 20 (med) | Mild linear ~1ms/blob |
| **ethrex** | 1 (med) | 7 (med) | 15 (med) | 24 (med) | 25 (med) | Mild linear ~1.2ms/blob |
| **Besu** | 3 (med) | 10 (med) | 19 (med) | 29 (med) | 31 (med) | Moderate, high tail variance |
| **go-ethereum** | 5 (med) | 60 (med) | 103 (med) | 149 (med) | 165 (med) | Strong linear ~8ms/blob |
| **erigon** | 6 (med) | 61 (med) | 103 (med) | 118 (med) | 169.5 (med) | Strong linear ~8ms/blob |

**Key takeaways:**
- **Nethermind** is fastest by far — median is 0ms regardless of blob count, implying sub-ms serving from cache.
- **Reth** and **ethrex** are very fast with gentle linear scaling (~1-1.2ms per additional blob).
- **go-ethereum** and **erigon** track each other closely with steep linear scaling (~8ms per blob), reaching ~165-170ms median at max blobs.
- **Besu** has moderate medians but shows extreme tail outliers (e.g. max 1492ms at 6 blobs, 1211ms at 17 blobs), suggesting occasional contention issues.

Here's the summary for **blob-devnet-0** (the noisiest devnet in the last 3 hours):

| Service | Error count (3h) | Share | Top noisy hosts |
|---|---|---|---|
| **execution** | 1,865,933 | 86% | prysm-reth-super-1 (817k), prysm-reth-super-2 (716k) — ~4,500 errors/min each |
| **beacon** | 249,034 | 11% | mev-relay-1 (44k), lighthouse-erigon-full-* (59k combined) |
| **validator** | 26,974 | 1.2% | lighthouse-besu-super-* (27k combined) |
| **bootnode** | 23,451 | 1.1% | bootnode-1 |
| **mev-relay-api** | 3,538 | 0.2% | — |
| **xatu-sentry** | 651 | — | — |

Total: **~2.17M error-level log lines** across ~50 hosts. Error volume is fairly steady hour-over-hour, hovering ~280k–335k in the most recent partial hour vs 630k at peak.

The execution layer dominates — `prysm-reth-super-1` and `2` alone account for 70% of all errors. The errors are primarily RLPx frame-header read failures in Nethermind nodes and TRACE-level "handling failed connection" messages from Reth nodes. On the consensus side, `mev-relay-1` and the `lighthouse-erigon-full` pairs are the noisiest beacon hosts.
